aquamania.name: Aquamania Water Park
aquamania.background: Located on the falls corridor, the water park operates seasonally around its pools, water slides and lazy river.
aquamania.observe: The attractions suit different visitors. The children’s area has interactive play equipment, while the larger water slides occupy a separate section.
aquamania.walk: Walk into Falls Avenue, check the height restrictions on arrival, and first choose the pool that's right for your group.
aquamania.photo: Photograph the bends of the water slides from the deck without blocking the exit area.
aquamania.question: Is the park open all year?
aquamania.answer: The operation is seasonal. Check the calendar before buying and do not count on the same attractions open every day.
aquamania.arrival: Use 7120 Falls Avenue as your destination and enter the Aquamania reception.
steps: Start with the children's area or the lower-intensity pools if the group has children.
Ride the water slides first, then head to the lazy river. Agree on a meeting point on the deck.
aquamania.extraQuestion: Where should I check the toy restrictions?
aquamania.extraAnswer: Read the plates and confirm with the crew on arrival, especially before you enter the line of the water towers.
aquamania.tagline: Pools, a lazy river and water slides on Avenida das Cataratas
aquamania.tip: Choose the season and compare the appropriate toys to the children's height before buying.
aquamania.notice: Check the rules for each pool and use the dry walkways between areas.
aquamania.stay: The waterway of the Avenida das Cataratas makes it easy to combine the water park with other walks on different days.

aguaray-eco.name: Aguaray Eco Esportes
aguaray-eco.background: The expedition combines a forest trail, a canoeing base in Iguaçu, and a stop by a waterfall.
aguaray-eco.observe: The contrast between the enclosed forest and the open view of the river appears when the group reaches the canoe base.
aguaray-eco.walk: Go to the base indicated in the confirmation in Remanso Grande. Find the driver, walk the Indian Ecological Trail and follow the instructions before rowing.
aguaray-eco.photo: Shoot the margin from the base. Keep the camera in a watertight bag before entering the kayak.
aguaray-eco.question: Is transportation from the hotel included?
aguaray-eco.answer: The route announced by the municipality does not include the route to the base. Confirm the meeting point in the reservation.
aguaray-eco.arrival: Arrange your ride to and from Alameda Caeté before setting out. The address on your booking is for the base, not the launch point on the river.
steps: Make the approach on foot with the driver and prepare the equipment at the canoeing base.
After rowing, simply proceed to the waterfall indicated by the crew and return with the group.
aguaray-eco.extraQuestion: What's worth taking to the trail and the rowing?
aguaray-eco.extraAnswer: Wear closed footwear that can get wet and carry water and waterproof protection for your cell phone.
aguaray-eco.tagline: Hiking and kayaking on the Iguaçu River
aguaray-eco.tip: Book a morning or an afternoon for the expedition and leave the tour arranged with the driver.
aguaray-eco.notice: River conditions can change. Confirm the itinerary and follow your guide’s instructions before entering the water.
aguaray-eco.stay: A base in the waterfall corridor region reduces displacement relative to a centre start.

avenida-pedro-basso.name: Pedro Basso Avenue
avenida-pedro-basso.background: The avenue gained local prominence through the green tunnel formed by the tipane cups. It is an urban road used on a daily basis.
avenida-pedro-basso.observe: Observe the continuity of the hearts and the light that crosses the branches. The appearance changes with flowering and with the time of year.
avenida-pedro-basso.walk: Start on the sidewalk of the avenue itself and move on until you find a view of the tree line without leaving the pedestrian area.
avenida-pedro-basso.photo: From the sidewalk, frame the repetition of the logs in perspective. Keep away from the track to photograph.
avenida-pedro-basso.question: Is there a doorman or a mailman?
avenida-pedro-basso.answer: It is a public avenue in Foz do Iguaçu. Follow the traffic signs and use the designated access points.
avenida-pedro-basso.arrival: Land in a permitted location near Avenida Pedro Basso. Continue along the sidewalk.
steps: Walk through a shaded stretch to observe the alignment of the tippers.
Turn around on the same side if there's no sign of a crossing nearby.
avenida-pedro-basso.extraQuestion: Are the tulips blooming all year round?
avenida-pedro-basso.extraAnswer: Flowering is seasonal. The cup tunnel can be observed even outside the flowering period.
avenida-pedro-basso.tagline: A leafy corridor of tipuana trees in Foz
avenida-pedro-basso.tip: Side lighting helps you see the tree canopies. Choose a quiet stretch with a continuous pavement.
avenida-pedro-basso.notice: This is an active road. Take photos from the pavement, away from driveways.
avenida-pedro-basso.stay: A downtown hostel works well to match the walk with other city stops.

blue-park-foz.name: Blue Park Foz
blue-park-foz.operator: Blue Park, at Mabu Thermas Grand Resort
blue-park-foz.background: The park grew in stages from the wave beach. The 2022 expansion incorporated children's areas and the slow river.
blue-park-foz.observe: Compare the open layout of the artificial beach with the winding lazy river and the elevated structures of the water slides.
blue-park-foz.walk: Enter the Blue Park reception and locate the children's area or beach before selecting the most intense toys.
blue-park-foz.photo: From a dry area, frame the curved edge of the beach with the water slides in the background to show how the park is laid out.
blue-park-foz.question: Can I go without being staying at the Mabu?
blue-park-foz.answer: There are tickets for a day's visit. See conditions and availability on the park channel.
blue-park-foz.arrival: Use the Blue Park entrance at 3175 Dr. Alberto Abujamra Street as a reference for your arrival.
steps: Check the wave programming before you descend to the artificial beach.
After the beach, choose between the slow river and the waterfalls according to the group profile.
blue-park-foz.extraQuestion: Where's the best place to start with kids?
blue-park-foz.extraAnswer: The children’s areas have smaller rides. Check which ones are operating on the day.
blue-park-foz.tagline: A wave beach and water attractions at the Mabu resort
blue-park-foz.tip: Check the forecast and the wave schedule for your visit, and set aside time to rest out of the water.
blue-park-foz.notice: Follow staff instructions on waves, water depth and access to the slides.
blue-park-foz.stay: Compare staying in the complex with hotels in the tourist corridor. Check if booking includes entry.

catedral-guadalupe.name: Our Lady of Guadalupe Cathedral
catedral-guadalupe.background: The diocesan cathedral is dedicated to Our Lady of Guadalupe and serves the tri-national Catholic community.
catedral-guadalupe.observe: Take a look at the large volume of the building, the curved lines of the roof and the whole main access.
catedral-guadalupe.walk: Get to Paraná Avenue. See the facade from the arrival area and visit the parish if you want to visit the interior.
catedral-guadalupe.photo: Frame the cover from the outside area, leaving room to show your height.
catedral-guadalupe.question: Can I visit during celebrations?
catedral-guadalupe.answer: See the diocesan schedule and avoid moving around or taking pictures that disrupt worship.
catedral-guadalupe.hours: Monday 14:00–17:30. Tuesday–Friday 08:00–11:30 and 14:00–17:30. Saturday 08:00–11:30. No visits on public holidays.
catedral-guadalupe.arrival: Come by Paraná Avenue, 5440, and confirm which gate the visit is made through.
steps: Check the roof and the main entrance before entering.
When the interior is open, stay in the permitted areas and exit by the indicated access.
catedral-guadalupe.extraQuestion: Is it worth separating the visit from the mass?
catedral-guadalupe.extraAnswer: If you want to observe architecture or take pictures, look for a visiting time that does not coincide with the celebration.
catedral-guadalupe.tagline: Curving forms and religious architecture on Avenida Paraná
catedral-guadalupe.tip: Plan your stop by temple visiting hours, especially if you want to see the interior.
catedral-guadalupe.notice: Stay in areas open to visitors and keep quiet during services.
catedral-guadalupe.stay: Village A is a practical base when the cathedral and Itaipu are on the same road.

dreams-eco-park.name: Dreams Eco Park
dreams-eco-park.background: The Eco Park is the outdoor area of the Dreams complex. Plan your route around the animal encounter areas and the operator’s published schedule.
dreams-eco-park.observe: Note the differences between public and animal areas.
dreams-eco-park.walk: At the entrance to the Dreams Park Show, confirm your entrance to the Eco Park and start with the marked path to the day-open grounds.
dreams-eco-park.photo: Prefers to photograph from the marked locations, without flashing and without asking for interaction with the animals.
dreams-eco-park.question: Is this the same circuit as the wax museum?
dreams-eco-park.answer: Eco Park has its own route and programming within the complex. Check the ticket options.
dreams-eco-park.arrival: Use 8100 Falls Avenue to get to the complex and follow the Eco Park signage.
steps: Check the schedule of the day before you go out on the roads.
Book the last part of the tour for the spaces that the team indicates are open at that time.
dreams-eco-park.extraQuestion: Can I feed the animals on my own?
dreams-eco-park.extraAnswer: Follow the rules of each enclosure. Any interaction should occur with the guidance of the team.
dreams-eco-park.tagline: Outdoor trails and viewing areas at the Dreams complex
dreams-eco-park.tip: Reserve the freshest part of the day if most of the visit is outdoors.
dreams-eco-park.notice: Do not cross enclosure barriers. Confirm which activities have fixed times in advance.
dreams-eco-park.stay: Cataract Avenue hotels make it easy to combine visits to the complex without repeating a long journey.

museu-de-cera-dreams.name: Dreams Wax Museum
museu-de-cera-dreams.background: The museum brings together natural-sized wax figures in scenes dedicated to cinema, music, sports and other themes.
museu-de-cera-dreams.observe: Look at the setting, the lighting, and the scenery. They help you identify the context of each character.
museu-de-cera-dreams.walk: At the complex box office, choose the wax museum and follow the sequence of rooms to explore the different themes.
museu-de-cera-dreams.photo: Use the lighting of the setting and keep the passage between the figures free.
museu-de-cera-dreams.question: Is the script internal?
museu-de-cera-dreams.answer: The collection is displayed in themed rooms. Check the complex’s website for access information and museum tickets.
museu-de-cera-dreams.arrival: Reception is at the Dreams complex, at 8100 Avenida das Cataratas. Look for the entrance to the wax museum.
steps: Choose a room to calmly observe the relationship between figure, figure and setting.
As you pass through the following rooms, leave the longest stops for the non-linear photo points.
museu-de-cera-dreams.extraQuestion: How much to book for photos?
museu-de-cera-dreams.extraAnswer: The time depends on the stops in each scene. If the group wants too many portraits, avoid marking another entry soon after.
museu-de-cera-dreams.tip: If you plan to take many pictures, leave time between your visit and your next ticket.
museu-de-cera-dreams.notice: Keep passages clear around photo sets and follow the signs on access to the figures.
museu-de-cera-dreams.stay: Consider Falls Avenue if other rides in your itinerary also stay in that corridor.

vale-dos-dinossauros.name: Dinosaur Valley
vale-dos-dinossauros.background: The Valley of the Dinosaurs is an outdoor themed trail with replicas amid the greenery of the Dreams complex.
vale-dos-dinossauros.observe: Compare the scale of the replicas and notice how the curves of the path hide or reveal the figures.
vale-dos-dinossauros.walk: Follow the signaled entrance of the Valley and walk through the circuit. Leave the photo stops out of the narrow areas.
vale-dos-dinossauros.photo: Frame an entire replica with the vegetation, without going through the fences to look for another angle.
vale-dos-dinossauros.question: Is the ride outdoors?
vale-dos-dinossauros.answer: Yes. Take protection for sun or rain and consult the operator about opening in case of bad weather.
vale-dos-dinossauros.arrival: Use the entrance to the complex on Falls Avenue and confirm access to the Valley Trail at the box office.
steps: Follow the signposted path and compare the first replicas with the greatest views ahead.
Go through the photographic points in the widest parts before heading out.
vale-dos-dinossauros.extraQuestion: Is it possible to visit without running to see everything?
vale-dos-dinossauros.extraAnswer: Yes. Choose some replicas to watch calmly and keep free circulation in the curves of the trail.
vale-dos-dinossauros.tagline: Large dinosaur replicas along an outdoor trail
vale-dos-dinossauros.tip: Preferably a more pleasant lighting time for walking and observing replicas in the vegetation.
vale-dos-dinossauros.notice: Wear walking shoes and stay on the marked trail, including when taking photos.
vale-dos-dinossauros.stay: If you travel with children, you can use a base in the tourist corridor to avoid long commutes between attractions.

feirinha-da-jk.name: JK Street Market
feirinha-da-jk.operator: City of Foz do Iguaçu and local vendors
feirinha-da-jk.background: The Free Nations Fair brings together farmers, artisans and food vendors in a tradition on Sunday in the center.
feirinha-da-jk.observe: Notice how the fruit and crafts tents blend with those of cake and coffee.
feirinha-da-jk.walk: Start at the street Arquitecto Décio Luis Cardoso, walk between the tents and leave the stop to eat for after you walk through the fair.
feirinha-da-jk.photo: Photograph ingredients and stalls with the vendor's permission. Preserve the circulation space.
feirinha-da-jk.question: Is it worth going on weekdays?
feirinha-da-jk.answer: The market is traditionally held on Sundays. Check the municipal calendar for holiday exceptions and schedule changes.
feirinha-da-jk.arrival: Combine the landing near Architect Decio Luis Cardoso Street and make the last stretch on foot through the center.
steps: First look at the fresh food sector and the products of the fairs.
Then go over to the craft and end up in the food business, where you can spend more time without loading groceries for the fair.
feirinha-da-jk.extraQuestion: Does visiting depend on buying something?
feirinha-da-jk.extraAnswer: The movement between the banks is free. You choose where to stop or consume.
feirinha-da-jk.tagline: Food, regional produce and crafts in downtown Foz
feirinha-da-jk.tip: You arrive in the morning to walk around the benches before choosing where to stop to eat.
feirinha-da-jk.notice: Crowd levels change over the morning. Keep the aisle free when stopping at a stall.
feirinha-da-jk.stay: A base in the center makes it easy to fit the Sunday fair before you go on another ride.

gramadao-da-vila-a.name: Vila A Park
gramadao-da-vila-a.background: The living space of Vila A has been revitalized with lighting, woodworking, ramps and acoustic shell interventions.
gramadao-da-vila-a.observe: The shell, the archbanks, and the lawn show how the space functions both in everyday life and on event days.
gramadao-da-vila-a.walk: You'll reach Silvio Américo Sasdelli Avenue, walk the public roads and end up in the sound shell area.
gramadao-da-vila-a.photo: From the open part of the lawn, use the shell as a background element without entering the event structures.
gramadao-da-vila-a.question: Are there performances every day?
gramadao-da-vila-a.answer: The lawn is also a living space. See the Itaipu calendar for presentation dates.
gramadao-da-vila-a.arrival: Look for public access through Avenida Silvio Américo Sasdelli. On event days, confirm the landing point.
steps: Walk through the paved entrances to observe the relationship between lawn and orchards.
Finish near the acoustic shell, respecting closed assembly or circulation areas.
gramadao-da-vila-a.extraQuestion: What's the difference between visiting with and without an event?
gramadao-da-vila-a.extraAnswer: On ordinary days, the attraction is the open space itself. During events, opening times and access depend on the programme.
gramadao-da-vila-a.tagline: An open lawn and bandshell in Vila A
gramadao-da-vila-a.tip: Check to see if the day is an event to choose between a quiet walk and a scheduled visit.
gramadao-da-vila-a.notice: When preparations for events are under way, respect closures and use open entrances.
gramadao-da-vila-a.stay: Village A is convenient to connect Gramadão to other stops north of Foz.

refugio-biologico-bela-vista.name: Bela Vista Biological Refuge
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.background: Itaipu created the refuge to restore vegetation and protect fauna affected by the construction of the plant. Today the site has research and environmental education.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.observe: Compare the restored vegetation areas with the management areas and hear the guide explain the purpose of each space.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.walk: Apply to the Visitor Reception Centre, follow the transport of the tour to the shelter and follow the trail with the guide.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.photo: Frame the plants from the designated trail, and follow the posted guidance on keeping your distance around enclosures.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.question: Can I go straight to the shelter?
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.answer: The tour starts at the Itaipu reception area. Use the meeting address on your booking.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.arrival: The first stop is the Itaipu Reception Center at 6702 Tancredo Neves Avenue.
steps: Embark with the group in the vehicle of the tour towards the Bela Vista Refuge.
Follow the guide on foot between the vegetation areas and the available enclosures.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.extraQuestion: Is this the same visit to the dam?
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.extraAnswer: It is another route, aimed at environmental restoration and fauna. Choose the ticket of the Refuge.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.tagline: A guided look at Itaipu’s ecological restoration
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.tip: Consider domestic transportation time beyond the walk. Make room before booking your next visit.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.notice: The visit is guided. Keep back from enclosures and check access conditions.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.stay: Village A reduces travel to the Itaipu reception, especially for morning departures.
refugio-biologico-bela-vista.duration: 2 h to 2 h 30 min, including the park shuttle and trail

adrena-kart.name: Adrena Kart Track
adrena-kart.background: The nearly one-kilometer track hosts competitions and also operates with rental kart sessions for visitors.
adrena-kart.observe: From the spectator area, follow the sequence of curves and the entrance of the karts in the straight line.
adrena-kart.walk: Get to Heleno Schimmelpfeng Street, check in, follow the directions, and only enter the track when authorized.
adrena-kart.photo: Shoot from off the track and use the curves as action reference. Do not cross the barriers.
adrena-kart.question: Can the visitor drive without his own kart?
adrena-kart.answer: There is rental with instruction before battery. Confirm age, height and equipment required directly with the operator.
adrena-kart.arrival: Get to the courtyard at 880 Heleno Schimmelpfeng Street and confirm the battery time.
steps: Do your credentials and listen to the instructions before you enter the karts area.
If you're just watching, use the public area to follow more than one section of the track.
adrena-kart.extraAnswer: Confirm escort access and stay in the area indicated to viewers.
adrena-kart.tagline: Corners, straights and karting sessions in Vila Yolanda
adrena-kart.tip: Choose the time from the available battery and leave time for accreditation.
adrena-kart.notice: Check height, age and equipment requirements. Only authorised people may enter the track.
adrena-kart.stay: The centre and the Villa Yolanda are options for those who want to fit the battery after an urban roadmap.

kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.name: Three Borders Kattamaram Cruise
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.background: The catamaran offers a river reading of the border, accompanying rivers that shaped the connections between neighboring cities.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.observe: Observe the water meets and bridges from the deck, paying attention to the side of each bank.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.walk: Use the boarding address in Porto Meira and arrive in accordance with the advance requested by the operator. After check-in, follow the guided shipment.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.photo: Choose a permitted point on the deck and frame each bridge laterally as the boat approaches.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.question: Do all times include meals?
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.answer: There are different modalities. Check the ticket if your tour includes lunch or dinner.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.arrival: Go to the boarding point at Porto Meira, at 1351 Meira Avenue, according to your reservation.
steps: Check-in on land and board when the crew calls.
From the deck, follow the approach of the bridges and the meeting of the rivers without blocking the passageways.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.extraQuestion: What point should I put as the destination of the car?
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.extraAnswer: Use the boarding address reported by Kattamaram, not the Three Border Frames address.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.tagline: See the rivers meet from a catamaran
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.tip: Select the session by the desired light and discard any tight routing before boarding.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.notice: Follow the crew’s directions, and check the boarding location and time in your booking confirmation.
kattamaram-tres-fronteiras.stay: Porto Meira is an alternative to reducing the return journey after a sunset departure.

mercado-publico-barrageiro.name: Barrageiro Public Market
mercado-publico-barrageiro.background: The Vila A market brings together food, local produce and crafts. Its name commemorates the workers who built the dam.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.observe: Observe the distribution of the boxes and the coexistence between shopping malls and dining areas.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.walk: Walk through Araucaria Avenue, scroll through the boxes, and choose where to stop to eat after comparing the options.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.photo: Frame the interior from wide areas. Ask for consent before photographing merchants closely.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.question: Do all boxes follow the same schedule?
mercado-publico-barrageiro.answer: Market events and vendors’ opening hours vary. Check the market’s own listings.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.arrival: Use the address at 140 Araucaria Avenue to get to the market.
steps: Take a look around the boxes before choosing what to buy.
Then look for a spot in the food area to observe market movement.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.extraQuestion: Is this a farmer's market or is it worth stopping to eat?
mercado-publico-barrageiro.extraAnswer: Both visits are possible, so if you're going to make a meal, check which boxes are open.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.tagline: Local food and memories of Itaipu’s construction in Vila A
mercado-publico-barrageiro.tip: Take the time to go around the boxes and choose where to cook a meal.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.notice: Check the market programme and whether the stall you want to visit is open.
mercado-publico-barrageiro.stay: Village A serves as a base for connecting the market to the rides at the Itaipu complex.

mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.name: Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Mosque
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.operator: Muslim community of the Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Mosque
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.background: Construction began in 1983 and ended in 1987 to serve the Muslim community of Foz. The dome and the two minarets define the facade.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.observe: Pay attention to the octagonal base, the arches and the arabesques if indoor visitation is permitted.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.walk: Get to Mecca Street and look for the entry indicated for visitors. Confirm clothing and prayer schedules before entering.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.photo: From the outside, choose an angle that includes the dome between the minarets; confirm permission to photograph inside.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.question: Is it possible to enter during prayers?
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.answer: Confirm the rules with the mosque and respect the religious use of the space.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.hours: Monday 14:00–17:30. Tuesday–Saturday 08:30–11:30 and 14:00–17:30. Closed on Sunday.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.arrival: Head to 599 Mecca Street and confirm where visitors should enter.
steps: First look at the dome and the minarets outside.
If there is authorized access, observe the interior decoration discreetly and follow the route requested by the community.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.extraQuestion: Do I need to confirm the dress code?
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.extraAnswer: Yes, check the mosque before you go, as it maintains a religious program in addition to visiting.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.tagline: A dome and minarets in the Monjolo neighbourhood
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.tip: Plan the visit outside prayers if the intention is to observe the interior calmly.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.notice: Check the dress code and ask permission before taking photographs inside.
mesquita-omar-ibn-al-khattab.stay: A base in the center works if the mosque is part of a day dedicated to the city's neighborhoods.

parque-lago-monjolo.name: Monjolo Lake Park
parque-lago-monjolo.background: The lake was formed in 1997 to protect Monjolo springs and became an integral part of the daily life of the neighborhood.
parque-lago-monjolo.observe: See the transition between grassland and water mirror, especially where the vegetation is reflected in the lake.
parque-lago-monjolo.walk: Enter the neighborhood's public entrance and walk around through open sections, without improvising on shoreline passages.
parque-lago-monjolo.photo: Use the reflection of the trees as a foreground from a fixed point on the edge.
parque-lago-monjolo.question: Is this a visit inside the national park?
parque-lago-monjolo.answer: It's an urban park in the Monjolo neighborhood, with its own address and access in Foz.
parque-lago-monjolo.arrival: Search the public entrance of the park in the Monjolo district. Use the lake as a local reference.
steps: Follow the open sections of the walk to the shore.
Return to the same access if you encounter isolated areas or a road disruption.
parque-lago-monjolo.extraQuestion: Is it worth matching with another point in the neighborhood?
parque-lago-monjolo.extraAnswer: It is possible to plan a stop at the Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Mosque, with your own timetable and entrance.
parque-lago-monjolo.tagline: A neighbourhood walk beside a city lake
parque-lago-monjolo.tip: Choose a cool time and take time for a short walk by the lake.
parque-lago-monjolo.notice: Keep to open areas and avoid making your own paths along the shore.
parque-lago-monjolo.stay: Preferably an urban base in Foz if you want to combine the lake with the neighborhood's commerce and religious attractions.

cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.name: Iguazú Falls — Argentine side
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.background: The Iguazú National Park was created in 1934 and inscribed as a World Heritage Site in 1984. Passages at different levels give access to distinct views of the falls.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.observe: Compare the height of the leaps on the Upper Circuit with the frontal views of the Lower Circuit as the sections are in operation.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.walk: Enter by Route 101, check the sign for open circuits and reserve time for displacement to the Diablo Gorge.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.photo: The permitted walkways allow for the alternation of wide frames with details of the jumps; keep the traffic free.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.question: Does the Brazilian ticket work in Argentina?
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.answer: Each park has its own ticket office. Those arriving from Brazil should plan the international crossing and check the applicable documentation.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.arrival: The entrance is on Route 101 in Argentina. If coming from Foz, plan your border crossing and your ride to the park entrance.
steps: Check the open circuits during the day and pick the one that requires the most movement first.
Book the second part of the tour for the upper or lower aisles you didn't make on the way.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.extraQuestion: Can I decide the sequence after I get there?
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.extraAnswer: Yes. Use the day information on the operation of the runways and the internal transport.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.tagline: Walkways above and in front of the falls in Misiones
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.tip: Reserve a day considering the circuits and the crossing if you leave Brazil.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.notice: Check which entrances and routes are open that day and what documents you need to cross the border.
cataratas-del-iguazu-argentina.stay: For an early entry on the Argentine side, consider Puerto Iguazú. From Foz, include the border in planning.

caminho-das-bananeiras.name: Bananeiras Trail
caminho-das-bananeiras.operator: ICMBio and the concession operator for the falls area
caminho-das-bananeiras.background: The trail extends for about 1.3 km in the Atlantic Forest to the Iguaçu River and the Taupá Space Deck.
caminho-das-bananeiras.observe: Observe the passage of the tree-lined corridor to the open bank and the width of the river before the falls.
caminho-das-bananeiras.walk: In the Visitor Center, confirm the stop for the Banana Road. Follow the route signaled to the Taupá and return as per local orientation.
caminho-das-bananeiras.photo: On the deck, frame the opposite margin from the public observation area.
caminho-das-bananeiras.question: Is it possible to ride a bicycle?
caminho-das-bananeiras.answer: The route is posted for walking and cycling. Confirm the rules and conditions of the day's journey.
caminho-das-bananeiras.ticket: Included in admission to Iguaçu National Park
caminho-das-bananeiras.arrival: Enter the park by the Visitor Center and ask for the stop of the Way of the Bananas. The km 18 is the general entrance.
steps: At the beginning identified, it follows the shady path to Iguaçu.
Stop at the Deck of Space Taupá to observe the opposite margin and confirm the return option.
caminho-das-bananeiras.extraQuestion: Does the address on the map match the deck?
caminho-das-bananeiras.extraAnswer: The map looks for the path by name. To reach the deck, follow the inner orientation of the park.
caminho-das-bananeiras.tagline: A shaded forest path to a deck overlooking the Iguaçu River
caminho-das-bananeiras.tip: Set the course before a visit to the falls only if the return time permits.
caminho-das-bananeiras.notice: Confirm the shuttle stop and stay on the marked path to Taupá.
caminho-das-bananeiras.stay: A base in the waterfall corridor makes it easy to get to the Visitor Center in the first hour available.

caminho-do-poco-preto.name: Poço Preto Trail
caminho-do-poco-preto.operator: ICMBio and the concession operator for the falls area
caminho-do-poco-preto.background: The trail runs about nine kilometers of Atlantic Forest in one direction, forming a distinct route from the Falls Pass.
caminho-do-poco-preto.observe: The forest corridor favors bird watching and environmental interpretation. Stop to listen before looking for movement in the cup.
caminho-do-poco-preto.walk: Get information at the Visitor Center about the Black Pit stop. Choose a walk or bike according to the layout for round trip.
caminho-do-poco-preto.photo: In long stretches, frame the perspective of the path and use zoom to observe wildlife from a distance.
caminho-do-poco-preto.question: What's the round-trip?
caminho-do-poco-preto.answer: The municipality informs about 18 km in total. Calculate the return before starting.
caminho-do-poco-preto.hours: Daily 09:00–12:00 for walkers and 09:00–15:00 for cyclists.
caminho-do-poco-preto.ticket: Included in admission to Iguaçu National Park
caminho-do-poco-preto.arrival: Use the Visitor Center to enter the park and inform the team that you're going to the beginning of the Black Well.
steps: At the beginning of the route, confirm the time available for pedestrians or cyclists.
Mark mentally the time spent on the trip and save room to return through the forest corridor.
caminho-do-poco-preto.extraQuestion: Is the walk to the end necessary to observe birds?
caminho-do-poco-preto.extraAnswer: It is possible to observe the environment from the first excerpts. Adjust the distance to the return time.
caminho-do-poco-preto.tagline: A long trail through the park’s Atlantic Forest
caminho-do-poco-preto.tip: Decide in advance how much you want to walk or cycle and include the return in the calculation.
caminho-do-poco-preto.notice: Carry water, check the cut-off time for your mode of travel and stay on the signed route.
caminho-do-poco-preto.stay: If you want to start early, you can stay in the tourist corridor and leave transportation to the agreed entrance.

trilha-ytepopo.name: Ytepopo Trail
trilha-ytepopo.operator: ICMBio and the concession operator for the falls area
trilha-ytepopo.background: The trail accompanies the shore of Iguaçu for about five kilometers. Its tracing allows to see the relationship between the forest and the river above the falls.
trilha-ytepopo.observe: In open sections, compare the river space with the vegetation of the shore.
trilha-ytepopo.walk: Confirm the starting point and return form with the park team before starting. Follow only the signaled path.
trilha-ytepopo.photo: He photographed the openings into the river from the trail, without going down to the shore to look for another angle.
trilha-ytepopo.question: Is this the same trail that leads to the lookout?
trilha-ytepopo.answer: This is a separate riverside route within the park. Check trail conditions and the designated access points.
trilha-ytepopo.ticket: Included in admission to Iguaçu National Park
trilha-ytepopo.arrival: Show the name Ytepopo at the Visitor Centre to confirm access and bus stop.
steps: Identify the signposted entrance and follow the stretch along the stream forest.
Use the road openings as stopping points and follow the direction of the park to return.
trilha-ytepopo.extraQuestion: Does the route end at the view of the falls?
trilha-ytepopo.extraAnswer: Ytepopo has its own itinerary on the edge of Iguaçu. Confirm the route before leaving.
trilha-ytepopo.tagline: A riverside walk upstream from the falls
trilha-ytepopo.tip: Check the internal access before dividing the day between the track and the main walkway.
trilha-ytepopo.notice: Do not scramble down to the water. Check trail conditions with park staff.
trilha-ytepopo.stay: An accommodation near the Falls Corridor saves you time if you book your morning on the trail.

roda-gigante-yup-star.name: Yup Star Ferris Wheel
roda-gigante-yup-star.background: The 88-meter-high wheel added a raised viewpoint to the landscape of Porto Meira, near the confluence of the rivers.
roda-gigante-yup-star.observe: During the tour, look for the meeting of the Iguaçu and Paraná rivers and compare the view of the city with that of the border landmarks.
roda-gigante-yup-star.walk: Get to Quixadá Street, pass the ticket office, and follow the boarding platform.
roda-gigante-yup-star.photo: Inside the cabin, close the glass lens to reduce reflections and keep the camera within the allowed aperture.
roda-gigante-yup-star.question: Does the wheel work when it sells too much?
roda-gigante-yup-star.answer: The operation can be suspended by the operator in wind conditions. Confirm before you go.
roda-gigante-yup-star.arrival: Get to 127 Quixadá Street and look for the wheel access, separate from the Marco entrance.
steps: Check the operation at the front desk, especially when there's strong wind.
In the cabin, use the climb to locate the city center and the descent to follow the meeting of the rivers.
roda-gigante-yup-star.extraQuestion: What time does it help to see the landscape?
roda-gigante-yup-star.extraAnswer: With steady weather, the late afternoon favors light over the rivers. Check the operating hours.
roda-gigante-yup-star.tagline: A high vantage point over the rivers and borders
roda-gigante-yup-star.tip: Choose a day with good visibility and allow for any change in wind operation.
roda-gigante-yup-star.notice: Wait for boarding instructions and keep your belongings inside the cabin.
roda-gigante-yup-star.stay: Porto Meira reduces displacement to a roadmap that includes the wheel and the Three Border Framework.

movie-cars.name: Movie Cars
movie-cars.background: The scenographic museum brings together cars associated with films, series and other popular culture productions in a sequence of thematic environments.
movie-cars.observe: Compare the vehicle with elements of the setting, indicating the time, characters or scene of reference.
movie-cars.walk: At the entrance to Wonder Park, confirm the Movie Cars ticket and go through the scenarios in circuit order.
movie-cars.photo: Frame the car together with the setting to distinguish the exhibit from a historic vehicle museum.
movie-cars.question: Does the ticket include the show at the lake?
movie-cars.answer: The complex sells different modalities. Check which activities appear in the ticket.
movie-cars.hours: Daily 14:00–17:00. After 17:00, access requires a combo, trio or full pass.
movie-cars.arrival: Please use the address of Wonder Park and request specific access to Movie Cars at the front desk.
steps: In each scenario, first look for the elements that identify the reference to the film or series.
Leave the entire vehicle photograph to environments with sufficient space off the passing path.
movie-cars.extraQuestion: Is it a good option if it rains?
movie-cars.extraAnswer: The exposure circuit works in scenic environments. Check schedules and conditions on the site of the complex.
movie-cars.tip: Choose the most interesting vehicles and movies to save more time in these scenarios.
movie-cars.notice: Respect the barriers around vehicles and confirm which experiences your ticket includes.
movie-cars.stay: Waterfalls Avenue hostels are practical for combining the museum with other corridor attractions.

circuito-sao-joao.name: São João Circuit
circuito-sao-joao.operator: ICMBio and the concession operator for the falls area
circuito-sao-joao.background: The 1.9 km track passes near traces associated with the former St. John's Mill. Between 1939 and 1943 the plant provided power for the structure of the park.
circuito-sao-joao.observe: Observe the relationship between the ruins, waterways and walls. Areas open to the public may change with the works or river conditions.
circuito-sao-joao.walk: Consult the team on arrival and landing at the stop indicated for the Park School. Follow the demarcated route of the circuit.
circuito-sao-joao.photo: Use the demarcated areas to photograph the waterfall and the rocky bed without climbing on wet rocks.
circuito-sao-joao.question: Is the trail included in the regular entrance?
circuito-sao-joao.answer: The municipal guide says yes. Confirm the operation and only use free bath points.
circuito-sao-joao.ticket: Included in admission to Iguaçu National Park
circuito-sao-joao.arrival: Please check with the Visitor Centre about the Park School access and the operating stop.
steps: On the signposted path, look at the waterways and the references to the old plant.
If there is an empty bathroom, check the conditions on the premises before entering and return by the route indicated.
circuito-sao-joao.extraQuestion: Can I count on a year-round bath?
circuito-sao-joao.extraAnswer: Access to water depends on daytime conditions and the areas liberated by the park.
circuito-sao-joao.tagline: Forest streams and traces of an old power station
circuito-sao-joao.tip: Plan your visit based on the condition of the trail and look for references to the plant before heading for the water.
circuito-sao-joao.notice: Only swim in areas that are open for bathing. Respect closures and keep off wet rocks.
circuito-sao-joao.stay: The Falls Corridor makes it easy to get out early to the park entrance and confirm the conditions with the team.

aquafoz.name: AquaFoz Aquarium
aquafoz.background: The aquarium showcases the ecosystems of the Paraná and Iguaçu river basins. Across three floors, tanks and interpretive displays explain these environments.
aquafoz.observe: Compare freshwater environments with saltwater environments and use the panels to understand the role of local basins.
aquafoz.walk: Use AquaFoz’s own entrance near the km 18 marker and follow the floor sequence shown at reception.
aquafoz.photo: Next to the glass, photograph without flash and wait for the animal to cross its frame instead of following the motion with the light.
aquafoz.question: Is the visit included in the waterfall ticket?
aquafoz.answer: The aquarium has its own operation and ticket office. Check out the tickets by AquaFoz.
aquafoz.arrival: In mile 18, locate the AquaFoz's own reception before heading to the waterfall entrance.
steps: In the first tanks, look for the water basin represented on the dashboard.
On the following floors, compare the environments and set aside time for interactive panels.
aquafoz.extraQuestion: Can you match the aquarium to the main track?
aquafoz.extraAnswer: Yes, with separate tickets. Allow time for the aquarium and the national park’s shuttle bus.
aquafoz.tagline: Freshwater and marine tanks and exhibits
aquafoz.tip: Take the time to read the panels of the local basins and go beyond the quick spin through the tanks.
aquafoz.notice: Do not use flash around the tanks. Check the last admission time posted by the ticket office.
aquafoz.stay: A base in the waterfall corridor makes it easy to combine the aquarium with the national park in separate entrances.

museu-foz-cars.name: Foz Cars Museum
museu-foz-cars.background: The collection started from the collection of Paulo de Oliveira Gouvea, started in the 2000s. Cars, motorcycles and trucks show different phases of the automobile industry.
museu-foz-cars.observe: Compare the 1910 Flanders Racy Roadster with the 1959 Cadillac De Ville to see changes in proportion and finish.
museu-foz-cars.walk: Walk into the waterfall avenue, walk through the two theme galleries, and check the vehicle IDs before heading to the cafeteria.
museu-foz-cars.photo: Use a three-quarter angle to show the front and sides of the vehicle without crossing the boundaries.
museu-foz-cars.question: Is it as attractive as Movie Cars?
museu-foz-cars.answer: Foz Cars deals with the evolution of historical vehicles; Movie Cars is a film-related circuit.
museu-foz-cars.arrival: Go to 9563 Cataract Avenue. The name Foz Cars helps distinguish the entrance of other automotive museums.
steps: Pick different decades vehicles on the first shelf to compare design and proportions.
In the next shed, read the license plates of cars, motorcycles and trucks before closing in the cafeteria.
museu-foz-cars.extraQuestion: Is the museum for collectors only?
museu-foz-cars.extraAnswer: The visual comparison between decades helps to understand the exposure even without any mechanical knowledge.
museu-foz-cars.tagline: Vehicles from different decades in two exhibition halls
museu-foz-cars.tip: Choose models from different eras to compare and allow time to read the chips on each shelf.
museu-foz-cars.notice: Photograph the exhibits without touching them and keep the aisles clear.
museu-foz-cars.stay: The corridor of the Avenida das Cataratas makes it easy to divide automotive museums and other attractions between several shifts.

dreams-ice-bar.name: Dreams Ice Bar
dreams-ice-bar.background: The ice bar is a refrigerated room of the Dreams complex. The furniture and ice sculptures make up the visiting experience.
dreams-ice-bar.observe: Observe how colored light penetrates the translucent parts and changes the appearance of the ice.
dreams-ice-bar.walk: Enter the complex and confirm at the reception the access to the Ice Bar, the session and the items of clothing provided before entering.
dreams-ice-bar.photo: Compose with illuminated sculptures. Protect the equipment when leaving the cold room to avoid condensation.
dreams-ice-bar.question: Can I use the same museum ticket?
dreams-ice-bar.answer: Ice Bar has its own access. Check out the composition of your ticket and the session options.
dreams-ice-bar.hours: Daily 10:00–22:00. The last session starts at 21:10.
dreams-ice-bar.arrival: Get to the Dreams complex and locate access to the Ice Bar at the front desk.
steps: Confirm the time of the session and place the thermal protection parts indicated.
Look at the ice furniture first and leave the sculpture photos in a less-motivated area.
dreams-ice-bar.extraQuestion: Is it worth taking an extra layer of clothing?
dreams-ice-bar.extraAnswer: Consult the operator about what is included and decide according to their cold tolerance.
dreams-ice-bar.tagline: Illuminated sculptures in a chilled room
dreams-ice-bar.tip: Arrange the bar session with a break between the other visits to the complex.
dreams-ice-bar.notice: Check what cold-weather protection is provided and shield your camera from condensation when leaving.
dreams-ice-bar.stay: Falls Avenue is convenient if the Ice Bar session is part of a day at Dreams.

maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.name: Wonders of the World
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.background: The exhibition presents reproductions of monuments and cultural landmarks from various places, assembled in indoor environments.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.observe: Compare the proportions and architectural details that are lost when a monument is reduced to a model.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.walk: Inside the complex, follow the sign to Wonders of the World, scroll through the panels in order of the circuit, and reserve a few minutes for the subtitles.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.photo: Frame each model to its base to give an idea of scale. Avoid supporting objects in the exhibition.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.question: Are the pieces originals from other countries?
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.answer: The visit is an exhibition of reproductions. Read the subtitles to identify the places represented.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.arrival: Use the box office at the Dreams complex and ask for the model exhibition by name.
steps: Start by reading the identification of each monument before moving on to the next piece.
Compare at least two different styles of construction and finish without blocking the corridors.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.extraQuestion: What's one way to have fun with kids?
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.extraAnswer: Choose a few replicas to find out what country they are from and compare elements such as towers, columns, or steps.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.tagline: Miniature monuments for comparing shapes and styles
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.tip: Choose a small set of models to observe more closely and read their subtitles.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.notice: Do not place belongings on the display bases. Take photos from the visitor aisle.
maravilhas-do-mundo-dreams.stay: The tourist corridor makes it easy to combine the exhibition with other Dreams visits without a new move.

dreams-motor-show.name: Dreams Motor Show
dreams-motor-show.background: The Motor Show combines an exhibition of classic and custom motorcycles with a themed bar and restaurant atmosphere.
dreams-motor-show.observe: Notice how tank, steering wheel, and finish change between standard and custom motorcycles.
dreams-motor-show.walk: Visit the Motor Show through the entrance of the complex and travel the exposed bikes first. If you are eating on site, check the house schedule.
dreams-motor-show.photo: Side photographer to show the profile of the motorcycle and keep the ambient lighting in composition.
dreams-motor-show.question: Is the visit the same as the Foz Cars Museum?
dreams-motor-show.answer: They are attractions at different addresses. The Motor Show focuses on motorcycles and is inside the Dreams Park Show.
dreams-motor-show.arrival: Go to the Dreams complex and check where the motorcycle circuit starts.
steps: Go through the oldest motorcycles and compare the silhouette to custom models.
After you look at the inventory, go to the dining room if you're up to it.
dreams-motor-show.extraQuestion: Do I need to make a meal?
dreams-motor-show.extraAnswer: You do not need to plan a meal to see the motorcycles. Contact the venue if you also want to visit the bar and restaurant.
dreams-motor-show.tagline: Classic and custom motorcycles in a themed venue
dreams-motor-show.tip: Decide whether you want to just see the exhibition or stay for dinner.
dreams-motor-show.notice: Stay in public viewing areas and do not touch the motorcycles.
dreams-motor-show.stay: Consider the Falls corridor if you visit other Dreams spaces on the same day.

ponte-da-amizade.name: Friendship Bridge
ponte-da-amizade.operator: Brazilian and Paraguayan road and border authorities
ponte-da-amizade.background: Construction began in 1956 and the bridge was inaugurated in 1965. The connection over Paraná brought Foz do Iguaçu and Ciudad del Este closer together.
ponte-da-amizade.observe: From a public spot on the shore, observe the arch and the position of the bridge in relation to the shopping centres on both sides.
ponte-da-amizade.walk: To see the bridge, choose an authorised public viewpoint in Vila Portes. To cross, consult the official rules and border access information.
ponte-da-amizade.photo: Photograph an authorised public spot outside traffic lanes and avoid stopping in border control areas.
ponte-da-amizade.question: Do I have to cross to see the bridge?
ponte-da-amizade.answer: It is possible to see it on the Brazilian side. International crossing is subject to the rules of the border authorities.
ponte-da-amizade.arrival: To see the structure of Brazil, look for an authorized public spot in Vila Portes and leave the car outside the border area.
steps: From a safe spot on the shore, observe the profile of the arch and river in the foreground.
If you are going to Ciudad del Este, check separately the border operation and the rules of crossing.
ponte-da-amizade.extraQuestion: Does the map indicate a place to stop over the bridge?
ponte-da-amizade.extraAnswer: The search identifies the bridge. Never use the traffic strip as a stop or photo point.
ponte-da-amizade.tagline: The road arch connecting Foz and Ciudad del Este
ponte-da-amizade.tip: Separate the observation plan structure from the border crossing plan.
ponte-da-amizade.notice: Never stop in a traffic lane. View the bridge only from authorised public areas.
ponte-da-amizade.stay: Vila Portes is convenient for the Brazilian riverbank. From downtown, arrange transport to the border area separately.

show-das-aguas-wonder-park.name: Wonder Park Water Show
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.background: The show occupies the theme park lake, where jets of water, light and projections make up a nightly presentation.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.observe: Notice how the jets delimit the projection area and how the lighting uses the lake as a background.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.walk: Get to Wonder Park, check the time, and follow the sign to the public area by the lake before the start.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.photo: Choose an open view location to photograph the jets without lifting the camera in front of the people behind you.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.question: A Movie Cars ticket gives you access to the show?
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.answer: Check the park arrangements and whether the show is included on the selected ticket.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.arrival: Use the entrance to Wonder Park and confirm the time of the presentation when you arrive.
steps: Follow to the lake shore and look for a point in the public area with open view.
At the end of the presentation, follow the exit indicated before picking up transport back.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.extraQuestion: Is this a morning fit attraction?
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.extraAnswer: The interest is in the night presentation. See the grid of the day before organizing the rest of the script.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.tagline: Water jets, lights and projections over the lake
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.tip: Confirm the session and arrive with a margin to choose a location with open vision.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.notice: If the programme changes, follow park staff and keep exit routes clear.
show-das-aguas-wonder-park.stay: A base in the waterfall corridor shortens the route after the night's show.

big-land-wonder-park.name: Big Land
big-land-wonder-park.background: This indoor venue reimagines toys and arcade games at a larger scale. Its themed sets evoke childhood memories from different generations.
big-land-wonder-park.observe: Compare the scale of the games to the height of the people and see how the traffic opens up space around the larger toys.
big-land-wonder-park.walk: At the entrance to the complex, follow the directions of the Big Land and start with the toy hall before exploring interactive games.
big-land-wonder-park.photo: Include a person next to a giant toy, with consent, to show the difference in scale.
big-land-wonder-park.question: Does it work on rainy days?
big-land-wonder-park.answer: The operator describes the space as covered and air-conditioned. Check the schedule and tickets on the Big Land website.
big-land-wonder-park.hours: Wednesday–Monday, 14:00–17:00. After 17:00, pass holders only until 22:00. Closed on Tuesday.
big-land-wonder-park.arrival: At the Wonder Park reception, ask the Big Land entrance by name, as the complex has several ticket offices and experiences.
steps: Start with the extended toys to observe the work of scale and setting.
Go through the interactive games after checking usage directions and rows in each area.
big-land-wonder-park.extraQuestion: Can I match up with the Water Show?
big-land-wonder-park.extraAnswer: Yes, according to the time and ticket mode. Check if the pass includes the two attractions.
big-land-wonder-park.tagline: Oversized toys and games in an indoor venue
big-land-wonder-park.tip: Combine a spin through the scenarios with time to play. Check out which experiences are included.
big-land-wonder-park.notice: Observe capacity limits on each game and follow the queue signs.
big-land-wonder-park.stay: Hospitality on the tourist corridor is practical to combine Big Land with other Wonder Park programs.
